metadata_evidence.2019_readme: Area (in hectares) and centroid coordinates (in kilometers; coordinate reference system EPSG:3067) of habitat patches.
metadata_evidence.2017_genetic_header: Patch Centroid_X (ETRS-TM35FIN); Patch Centroid_Y (ETRS-TM35FIN), meter units

only_authorized_change.distance_output: divide Euclidean meter distance by 1000 for km

all_scientific_choices: Inherit every year, target, source policy, host gap grid, family grouping, qualification rule and comparator unchanged from parent v1.
strict_checks: before any km output require parent v1 numeric CRS gate after conversion
at least 100 matched cross-archive coordinates; median<=1000m and q95<=5000m
same 12 year-policy panels; no new years or response-dependent exclusions
two-year source set can only weakly decrease minimum required r at fixed host gap; if not, stop
source k-m and family distances are descriptive assumptions not empirical dispersal ceilings
result_claim: Exploratory observation-conditional critical transition distance and ordinal host-gap trade-off, not historical migration, true colonization or generic EOG predictive advantage.
